SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) + interval '1 minute' AS time,
  integration_id, kind, name, avg(raw_19) * 0.1 AS raw_19
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE time >= date_subtract(date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki'), interval '1 day', 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time < date_add(date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki'), interval '1 day', 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time > now() - interval '2 days'
  AND integration_id = 'tuya' AND kind = 'devices' AND name = '3D printer' AND raw_19 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time, integration_id, kind, name, price
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE time >= date_subtract(date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki'), interval '1 day', 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time < date_add(date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki'), interval '1 day', 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time > now() - interval '2 days'
  AND integration_id = 'nordpool' AND price IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) + interval '1 minute' AS time,
  integration_id, kind, name, device_id, topic, avg(raw_19) * 0.1 AS raw_19
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE time >= date_subtract(date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki'), interval '1 day', 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time < date_add(date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki'), interval '1 day', 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time > now() - interval '2 days'
  AND integration_id = 'tuya' AND kind = 'devices' AND name = '3D printer' AND raw_19 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 ORDER BY 1

SELECT least(time_bucket($__interval_ms * interval '1 ms', time) + $__interval_ms * interval '1 ms', $__timeTo()) AS time, avg(tempc) AS tempc
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND device_id = 'C76A03460A73' AND brand = 'SwitchBot'
  AND (tempc IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
